def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]; seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[r[:] for r in g]
    comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if not seen[r][c] and g[r][c]!=bg:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(0,1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==col:

    for (y,x) in top['cells']: out[y][x]=0
    return out

def comps(g,bg=None):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    if bg is None: bg=g[0][0]
    seen=set(); out=[]

        for c in range(W):

from collections import defaultdict as dd
for n in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ch={(r,c):go[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]}
    tgt=set(ch.values()).pop()
    cs=comps8(gi,bg)
    # family: group by shape (norm key), within family group by color
    fam=dd(list)
    for comp in cs:
        p=comp['cells']; r0=min(r for r,c in p); c0=min(c for r,c in p)
        k=tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in p))
        fam[k].append(comp)
    print('demo',n,'bg',bg,'target',tgt,'changed_cells',len(ch),'changed_comps',[(p,(gi[q]) for q in sorted(p))[:3] for p in list({q:k for k,v in [(q,{p:q} for p,q in ch.items()} )}.keys())][:3], '->',sorted(set(ch.values())))
    for k,v in fam.items():
        # per color within family
        grp=dd(list)
        for comp in v: grp[comp['col']].append(comp)
        for col,ms in grp.items():
            tot=sum(len(m['cells']) for m in ms)
            chg=[m for m in ms if any(q in m['cells'] for q in ch)]
            print('   shape'%k,col,len(ms),'size%s'%(tot,'/'+str(len(chg)*max(len(m['cells'] for m in chg))) if chg else ''), 'changed:'+str(len(chg)), 'sizes',[len(m['cells']) for m in chg][:4])

steps.input:
for n in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(gi,bg)
    changed_cells={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]}
    tgt=[o for o in cs if o['cells']&changed_cells][0]
    S=norm(tgt['cells'])
    fam=defaultdict(list)
    for o in cs: fam[norm(o['cells'])].append(o)
    others=[o for o in fam[S] if o is not tgt]
    outcol={go[r][c] for r,c in changed_cells}.pop()
    print(f'=== demo{n}: bg={bg}; tgt col={tgt["col"]} size={len(tgt["cells"])} twin_cols={[o["col"] for o in others]}')
    for o in [tgt]+others[:4]:
        rr=min(r for r,_ in o['cells']); cc=min(c for _,c in o['cells'])
        print('   comp at',(rr,cc),'col',o['col'],'touch_edge',o['touch_edge'],'size',len(o['cells']))
